patterns.title: Zero items collected, exit 0
patterns.one_line: The runner executed successfully and collected nothing, which is reported as success.

patterns.title: Early return as an implicit skip
patterns.one_line: A guard exits the test body instead of reporting a skip — so the test appears to have passed.

patterns.title: Swallowed exception
patterns.one_line: A `try/except` added "for robustness" deletes the failure signal.

patterns.title: Sentinel value on failure
patterns.one_line: A function returns `0.0` / `""` / `[]` when it fails, so a crash becomes indistinguishable from a bad result.

patterns.title: Neutral marker not counted
patterns.one_line: "Expected but absent" is reported as a neutral note, so it never increments the failure counter — and the gate prints PASS.

patterns.title: Undeclared means unchecked
patterns.one_line: The validator checks exactly what the registry declares, so anything the registry forgot to declare is never checked — and never missed.

patterns.title: Empty value is silent
patterns.one_line: A required field is empty, and nothing anywhere breaks — the page loads, the API responds, the reference resolves.

patterns.title: Loading artifact as evidence of use
patterns.one_line: A file written at startup proves *loaded*. It is being read as proof of *used*.

patterns.title: Exposure counted as usage
patterns.one_line: Content is present in every request, so a search for it returns a large number — which is read as usage.

patterns.title: Local green is not remote green
patterns.one_line: Every local gate passes; the published artifact is still inconsistent, because the published artifact is a different object.

patterns.title: The always-green oracle
patterns.one_line: An exemption clause fires on any match, so the check passes unconditionally — including on the exact input it exists to catch.

patterns.title: Misattributed failure
patterns.one_line: The check fails — and blames the wrong cause, so the real defect is never fixed.

patterns.title: Stale copy contaminates the check
patterns.one_line: A pre-change backup is written inside the directory being checked, so the check reads an old copy as fresh input.

patterns.title: Zombie process looks alive
patterns.one_line: A hung process reports no error, holds no CPU and never exits — so every liveness signal says it is fine.

patterns.title: Stale reference: citations rot when the cited state moves
patterns.one_line: A document cites an external object's *state* (issue open/closed, version, link alive) but carries no re-check mechanism, so the citation silently inverts its meaning when the cited state changes.
